aliases.titulo: The Mysterious Gaze of the Flamingo

sinopsis.es: 1982. Una enfermedad desconocida en un pueblo minero chileno lleva a acusar a los hombres gay de transmitirla con la mirada. Lidia, de 12 años, busca la verdad.
sinopsis.en: As an unknown and deadly disease begins to spread, legend has it that it is transmitted by the mysterious gaze of the flamingo. In a small coastal town, a community struggles to protect themselves while confronting fear, superstition, and the fragility of human connection.
